answers.core: This fix would need to be integrated into the editor.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around by overriding the _Input method of EditorPlugin, but this is awkward, requires you to package your tool into a plugin and the mouse position you are given to work with in in screen coordinates.  You also lose back-to-front ordering with respect to the other nodes.  Having this as part of the base functionallity would make things much easier.

https://godotforums.org/discussion/comment/60654#Comment_60654

title: CanvasItem nodes should provide way for indicating they have been selected when used as a [Tool] in editor
